{{Top|leg}}
'''Scoopball''' was a game played in courts. In the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], it was somewhat popular among [[Senator/Legends|senators]]&mdash;many of whom were, at one point or another, injured enough while playing to warrant attention in the [[Galactic Senate Medcenter/Legends|Galactic Senate Medcenter]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
